name: Sunset dinner raft

seo.title: Sunset Dinner Raft, Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
seo.metaDescription: Sunset in the Koh Lanta mangrove on a private wooden raft, a seafood dinner by candlelight, then the glowing plankton in the dark water. From 3,900 THB.

h1: Sunset dinner on a private raft
lead: The mangrove at the end of the day, a seafood dinner by candlelight on your own wooden raft, then the plankton glowing in the dark water.
promise: Sunset, seafood dinner and glowing plankton

facts.label: Where
facts.value: Thung Yee Peng, east coast of Koh Lanta

options.label: Private raft, sunset dinner
options.note: Seafood dinner and the plankton after dark. One price for the whole raft. Under 3 free. From 3 years, each child counts as one person. For more than 8 people, ask us on WhatsApp.

steps.text: Check-in at Thung Yee Peng pier.
The raft cruises through the mangrove forest. Watch the wildlife and the monkeys.
Seafood dinner by candlelight on the raft.
A short cruise in the dark to see the plankton glow when you touch the water.

included: Hotel transfer both ways, within the Koh Lanta area
Seafood dinner, drinking water and seasonal fruit
The raft for your group only

beforeYouBook.children: The raft is private, for your group only. Under 3 free. From 3 years, each child counts as one person.
beforeYouBook.cancellation: Please tell us at least 24 hours before.

faq.a: Yes. After dinner the raft goes out in the dark, and the plankton glows blue when you touch the water.

faq.q: Can we fish from the raft?
faq.a: Yes. Fishing gear is on board.
Couples, families and friends. The raft is for your group only.
